historical_baseline.immutability_rule: A refreshed export must receive a new versioned release tag, preserve original observation IDs, and never silently overwrite historical frozen inputs or claim predictive improvement.

integrated_evidence_modules.role: Full IC50/binding coverage audit and explicit context availability
integrated_evidence_modules.non_replacement_note: Extends binding metadata provenance without mutating measured IC50/KD values or censoring flags.

integrated_evidence_modules.role: Source-reviewed binding assay conditions, preparation distinctions, and replicate provenance
integrated_evidence_modules.non_replacement_note: Separates purified recombinant MHC from cellular/lysate assays and keeps replicate provenance explicit.

integrated_evidence_modules.role: Access-aware TCRvdb receptor-specificity adapter with schema validation and anti-fabrication guards
integrated_evidence_modules.non_replacement_note: Separate receptor evidence contract; never conflated with MHC binding or elution positives.

integrated_evidence_modules.role: Packaged HAP1, C1R (SRR7065975), and 721.221-Cas9-sgNT (SRR23958328-330) bulk RNA-seq TPM anchors
integrated_evidence_modules.non_replacement_note: Cell-line expression sidecar; clone/perturbation provenance remains distinct from parental lines.

integrated_evidence_modules.role: PeptidomicsDB metadata qualification and capture-vs-compartment / PEAKS reanalysis provenance guard
integrated_evidence_modules.non_replacement_note: Zero native APC cohorts admitted; metadata availability does not establish cellular concentration.

integrated_evidence_modules.role: Quantitative HAP1 elution/proteomics selection covariates and replicate lineage
integrated_evidence_modules.non_replacement_note: Preserves HLA-selected elution vs whole-cell proteomics distinction and missing-is-not-zero semantics.

integrated_evidence_modules.role: Nanaware 2024 lymph/DC quantitative measurement grain and preparation guards
integrated_evidence_modules.non_replacement_note: Preserves raw vs normalized LFQ grain and prevents collapsing distinct lymph/DC preparations.

integrated_evidence_modules.role: HLA Ligand Atlas community SDRF, acquisition alias, and QC-inclusion lineage audit
integrated_evidence_modules.non_replacement_note: Primary donor cohort (atlas-donor-lineage-v1) is a separate evidence contract; physical specimen and acquisition lineage remain inconclusive until QC-included run/result crosswalk resolves, and mirrors must be excluded before Presto consumption.

integrated_evidence_modules.role: Canine DLA-88 / DLA-DR qualification, vital-organ blacklist guard, and OncoRef bulk MS separation
integrated_evidence_modules.non_replacement_note: Non-human DLA evidence stays separate from human training cohorts unless explicitly requested.

source_backed_reuse_links.rule: Sarkizova 2020 (PMID 31844290) reuses 16 monoallelic 721.221 datasets from Abelin 2017 (PMID 28228285, MSV000080527). Original and reanalyzed datasets must remain in the same partition for experiment-independent evaluation.
Liepe 2016 (PMID 27846572) reuses the primary human fibroblast immunopeptidome dataset from Bassani-Sternberg 2015 (PMID 25576301). Original and reanalysis must stay together.
Lola H58A and Lola BB7.6 are two immunoprecipitations from the same canine osteosarcoma tumor and donor; they must never be split across donor-disjoint or specimen-disjoint partitions.

Primary HLA Ligand Atlas donor cohort preserves 21 donors (967,449 observations), while physical specimen and raw acquisition lineage remain unknown/inconclusive; must not be combined with IEDB/reanalysis mirrors as independent evidence.

semantic_invariants: No-overlap with unresolved required biological identities must emit verdict='inconclusive', never 'pass'.
Not-applicable cellular axes (purified_mhc) do not substitute for experiment/source/reanalysis reuse checks.
Original observation IDs must be preserved across curation refreshes; source acquisition updates must be distinguished from annotation-only curation changes.
Refreshed training exports must never silently overwrite historical frozen releases or claim predictive improvement without downstream evaluation.
